messages:
alice: FYI Acme opened a support ticket — large batch run hit a bunch of 5xxs and gateway timeouts ~17:42 UTC. They said requests queued then started getting 504/502.
jamal: Oncall here. Can you drop a couple of request IDs and the window? Any recent deploys or config changes around autoscaling?
alice: Request IDs: req=acme-req-1, acme-req-2. No deploys on prod in the last hour. Pasting front proxy log snippet:
```
2026-02-14T17:42:01Z ERROR gateway upstream request failed 502 tenant=acme req=acme-req-1 route=/v1/generate err="upstream timeout"
2026-02-14T17:42:02Z ERROR scale_manager provision failed tenant=acme err="no available GPU pool for profile:low-latency"
2026-02-14T17:42:03Z WARN keda controller suppressing activation scaledObject=acme-ingest cooldown=300s minReplicaCount=0
```
jamal: Hmm. That keda log stands out — scaledobject suppression + minReplicaCount=0. If the ScaledObject cooldown is long it can block warmup. Can you run `kubectl get scaledobject -n inference acme-ingest -o yaml` and paste annotations?
alice: Pasted output below (trimmed):
```
metadata:
  name: acme-ingest
  annotations:
    keda.k8s.io/cooldown: "300"
    redwood.io/prewarm-suppression: "true"
spec:
  minReplicaCount: 0
  pollingInterval: 30
```
ingrid: Also flagging that auth-service shows a token rotate at 17:39 which produced a burst of 401s to the gateway, and billing metadata svc returned 429s for ~90s. Combined, downstream backpressure spiked request queue depth — makes warmup worse.
jamal: That chain can absolutely cause a thundering startup: queued requests -> scaler suppressed -> nodes not provisioned. Immediate mitigation: bump minReplicaCount to 1 and shorten cooldown. Will propose patch.
tara: Agreed. Temporary workaround: `kubectl patch scaledobject acme-ingest -n inference --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicaCount","value":1},{"op":"replace","path":"/metadata/annotations/keda.k8s.io~1cooldown","value":"60"},{"op":"replace","path":"/metadata/annotations/redwood.io~1prewarm-suppression","value":"false"}]'`
jamal: Applying now.
```
$ kubectl patch scaledobject acme-ingest -n inference --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicaCount","value":1},{"op":"replace","path":"/metadata/annotations/keda.k8s.io~1cooldown","value":"60"},{"op":"replace","path":"/metadata/annotations/redwood.io~1prewarm-suppression","value":"false"}]'
scaledobject.keda.sh/acme-ingest patched
```
deploy-bot: scaledobject acme-ingest updated by jamal (patch)
jamal: Triggering synthetic traffic now to verify. Initial 200s returned to 95% within a minute; tail 504s dropping. Keeping an eye on queue depth and provision metrics.
alice: Customer on call, reporting improvement but wants RCA and timeline. I'm escalating to SRE lead.
tara: Next steps: 1) keep minReplicaCount=1 for the next 6 hours while we stabilize, 2) roll back the prewarm-suppression flag change we shipped last week for tenant-burst (it suppressed helpful warmups), 3) add alert for scaledobject suppression state and KEDA cooldown > 120s, 4) correlate with auth/billing retry spikes in observability for a combined playbook.
jamal: I'll add traces and attach ephemeral pod init logs for Acme's tenant route. Will post repro steps after we collect traces.
pd-bot: Incident acknowledged and assigned to SRE oncall.
alice: Thanks everyone, will update customer and keep thread open for RCA notes.
